parts.name: Diverter Valve Complete
parts.description: Switches the flow of hot water between the radiators and the taps. Classic fault: heating works but there is no hot water, or the reverse. Supersedes part 178978.

parts.name: Water Pressure Sensor
parts.description: Reports the system water pressure to the control board. A bad sensor triggers false low-pressure warnings (F.22) and shutdowns.

parts.name: Expansion Vessel 10L
parts.description: Rectangular 10 litre vessel with 3/8 inch connection. Absorbs the expansion of water as it heats; when it fails, pressure climbs and the relief valve drips.

parts.name: Fan Assembly
parts.description: Pushes air in and exhaust gases out of the boiler. A whining noise or a fan-fault error code means it is wearing out.

parts.name: High Efficiency Pump
parts.description: Pushes hot water around the radiator circuit. Cold radiators while the boiler runs, or a loud humming, usually point here.

parts.name: Ignition Electrode Assembly
parts.description: Generates the spark that lights the gas burner, with separate leads for CDi models. A worn electrode means the boiler clicks repeatedly but never lights.

parts.name: Electrode Kit
parts.description: Replacement ignition and sensing electrodes for Greenstar i-series boilers. A standard item during annual service when sparking gets unreliable.

parts.name: Automatic Air Vent
parts.description: Automatically releases trapped air from the heating circuit. Gurgling noises and cold radiator tops are the usual signs it has stuck.

parts.name: Flow Sensor Assembly
parts.description: Detects when a hot tap is opened so the boiler fires for hot water. No hot water with working heating often points here. Supersedes part 87161157540.

parts.name: Ignition Electrode
parts.description: Generates the spark that lights the gas burner. A worn electrode means repeated clicking, ignition lockouts and an L2 fault code.

parts.name: Flame Detection Electrode
parts.description: Confirms to the control board that a flame is actually burning. A faulty electrode makes the boiler light and then shut down seconds later.

parts.name: Fan Assembly
parts.description: Pushes air and exhaust gases through the boiler. A whining noise or an F3 fan-fault code means it is wearing out.

parts.name: Burner Gasket
parts.description: Heat-resistant seal replaced during the annual service to keep combustion gases safely inside the boiler.

parts.name: Pressure Relief Valve Kit
parts.description: Safety valve that discharges water if system pressure gets too high. Replaced when it weeps constantly after a pressure spike.

parts.name: Flow Turbine
parts.description: Spins as hot water is drawn and tells the boiler to fire. A jammed turbine means taps run cold while the heating still works.

parts.name: Main Control Board (PCB)
parts.description: The brain of the boiler: sequences ignition, pump and fan. Replaced when the boiler is completely dead or throws random error codes.
